rule: A record is marked proven at an app or venue only with 50 picks logged before their start and graded against Pinnacle's own close at the pick's number, a CLV t of 2 or more, and results not running 1.5 sd under what that close expected. Never pooled across apps or venues. Picks logged after the start (imported histories included) are shown on each record and never counted.
note: Records appear once they have one pick logged before its start. A bettor can take their record off this list from MY SLIPS; the record stays at its own link. Line Reaper does not check who is behind a handle.
